fair_value_reason: Agents' round-4 blends average $22.7. On common settled inputs (GPU capex 2.2x revenue, corporate about $1.0-1.2bn, first re-lease 0.60, A3's guide-gap line reclassified, contract rates as used), the split-rate DCFs come to about A1 -$16, A2 -$3, A3 -$6, A4 -$5, A5 -$9.5 (central about -$7; about +$5 to -$9 at the 2.0x management-payback bound). EV/EBITDA at 7.5x averages $37.4. 0.4 x -$7 + 0.6 x $37.4 is about $20 ($22 if the DCF is floored at zero for limited liability). Uses about 450m diluted shares today and 555-595m at Oct-2027, with customer prepayments as debt.
supervisor_summary: Round 4 rebuilt every DCF site by site from the checked inventory and split discounting. All five now carry the 17 sites once, with NVIDIA outside the $4bn and Sweetwater 1 phase 1 inside 0.8GW, and all use well-anchored contract rates (Microsoft about 7% on the verified A-rated 6.00% facility; non-IG 10% on the verified 9% paper). The split adds only about $1/share. The DCF spread ($-8 to $13) came from GPU capex per $ of revenue, corporate cost and re-lease pricing. Settled on IREN's own orders (2.2x), cash SG&A (about $1.0-1.2bn at scale) and the 0.60 re-lease evidence, the DCFs reconcile to about -$16 to -$3 (central -$7; single-rate about $1 lower). A3's $2.0bn guide-gap line is early pipeline spend under the CFO's guide wording, so it is reclassified. Fair value is cut to about $20 from the agents' $22.7, carried by the 7.5x EBITDA leg. I keep the mean ladder (median about $33), low confidence and the $21 break.
key_drivers: GPU capex per $ of annual revenue: IREN's orders imply 2.2-2.35x on market-priced deals (3.0x on Microsoft). At 2.2x a GPU cycle earns about WACC, so the DCF is near or below zero; at 1.7-1.8x it is +$8-13. This is now the single largest input (A4: about $5/share per $1m/MW of GPU cost).
Funding the $25-30bn FY27 capex: $14bn in hand, about $8bn more GPU financing and prepayments targeted, and the rest from DC financing and ATM equity. Shares about 555-595m by Oct-2027.
Horizon 2-4 acceptance (Q4 CY2026, grace to the start of Q2 2027) and NVIDIA commissioning (early 2027), taking contracted ARR from $1bn operating to about $4.7bn.
Price and terms on the uncontracted 2027 capacity (S04, S05, S09, S10; 456MW IT): management cites ~$25m/MW talks (unverified). Air-cooled retrofits clear WACC; new liquid builds roughly break even.
How the market capitalises contracted NTM EBITDA (CoreWeave about 7.5x): the bridges average $37 at 7.5x, which carries the stock while the DCF does not.
